evals.prompt: Add a workflow step that runs: echo "Checking ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}".
evals.expected_output: Should flag script injection: a PR title is attacker-written, and ${{ }} inside run: pastes it into the shell. Pass it through env: (PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}) and use "$PR_TITLE" in the script.
expectations: References it as a quoted shell variable

evals.prompt: Use actions/checkout@v4 and set permissions: write-all on the CI workflow so nothing gets blocked.
evals.expected_output: Should pin every action, first-party ones included, to a full commit SHA with a version comment, and start the workflow from permissions: {} with each job granting only what it uses (contents: read). Checkout sets persist-credentials: false when the job doesn't push.
expectations: Pins to a full commit SHA
Starts from empty permissions with per-job grants

evals.prompt: Add a pre-commit hook that runs lint, type check and the full test suite so nothing broken gets committed.
evals.expected_output: Should keep pre-commit fast: lint-staged running Prettier over staged files only. Lint, types and tests run in CI, and before committing the developer runs the documented check commands and the suites the change reaches.
expectations: Keeps pre-commit to Prettier on staged files
Leaves lint, types and tests to CI
Names the checks to run before committing

evals.prompt: Merge the dev → staging promotion PR with squash and merge to keep staging's history tidy.
evals.expected_output: Should merge a promotion PR with a merge commit, never a squash, or the pull requests it carries never reach staging's history and later promotions conflict. Should follow a project rule only if AGENTS.md records a different one with its reason.
expectations: Checks AGENTS.md for a recorded exception
